question: There are _______ hand gestures in Mohiniyattam which are mainly adopted from Hastalakshana Deepika text.
solution:
The correct answer is __**24**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mohiniyattam is literally interpreted as the dance of ‘***Mohini***’.
 
• It is one of the two classical dance forms that originated in Kerala, the other one being Kathakali.
 
• It contains **24 **hand gestures in Mohiniyattam which are mainly adopted from Hastalakshana Deepika text.
 
• It is based on **Natya Shastra’s lasya style.**
 
• It has delicate movements and more **feminine facial** expressions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The repertoire of Mohiniyattam includes music in the **Carnatic style,** singing and acting a play through the dance, where the recitation may be either by a **separate vocalist **or the dancer themselves.
 
• The song is typically in Malayalam-Sanskrit hybrid called **Manipravalam**
 
• The movements are **gentle and glide-like.**
 
• They do **not** have terse rhythmic steps.
 
• More emphasis is on the** facial expressions **and** hand gestures.**
